values.note: Dodge County: electric sites $30 a night, non-electric $20 (whether a motorhome may book the lettered non-electric sites was not read, so the base stays the electric rate); $6 non-refundable reservation fee; the first two tents are included, each further tent $15 a night.

fees.source: https://www.co.dodge.wi.gov/lrp-parks/fees ('Electric Sites - $30'; 'Non-Electric - $20'; 'Reservation Fee $6 (non-refundable)'; 'Extra Tent(s) 1st two tents included on site cost. Each subsequent tent $15 per night.')

note: Dodge County park (83 acres) on the Niagara Escarpment, overlooking Horicon Marsh between Horicon and Mayville. The campground is in the heavily wooded upper area, with the Fort Ledge playground and hiking trails along the ledge. Mostly back-in sites. --Claude
summary: County page/fees/map + Premier banner: 41 sites (23 x 30A + 16 non-electric + 2 group), $30 electric / $20 non-electric + $6 fee, season Apr 15-Oct 31, 2027 closure Apr 15-May 16 for resurfacing, showers/flush/vault/dump. max_rig_ft 32 cleared (unsourced). Pin ~780 m off (entrance road among fields).
flags: PIN 43.4618,-88.5814 is the park's posted main-entrance coordinate (the map's 43 27.706 N, 88 34.875 W), on Park Road among farm fields ~750 m south of the camping area. Proposed 43.4688,-88.5826: the end of the campsite road by the shelter/playground clearing (Esri World Street Map's park road loop; a camper is visible at the clearing edge on Esri imagery). The electric loop itself is under leaf-on canopy and could not be seen; placement is from the road and the clearing.
SEASON 2027: Premier Campground's notice says the park closes April 15-May 16, 2027 for resurfacing (subject to change) - written to season.note; not a current status.

FEES: non-electric sites are $20 but the county does not say whether a motorhome may use the lettered sites (the note called them 'primitive'); the Premier site list needs a dated search that was not run. Base kept at $30.
WEBSITE and PHONE 920-386-3700 confirmed (park page; the reservation line is ext. 1).
Waterfront 'not waterfront' kept: the campground is on the wooded escarpment; the only water is the lower area's wildlife pond and the marsh below.
